label: BUILD
blurb: Ship a new feature or capability that isn't there yet.

stages.label: PLAN
stages.instructions: Read the code this touches and produce a short plan: approach, files, risks, how it will be verified. Do not write code in this stage.

stages.label: IMPLEMENT
stages.instructions: Execute the approved plan. Match the surrounding code's style. List every file changed as you go. Show the hunk for each file you changed — a diffstat nobody can check is a claim, not a change.

stages.label: VERIFY
stages.instructions: Run the tests and any 'done when' checks from the brief. Report exact commands and results; never claim pass without output.

stages.label: SHIP
stages.instructions: State what shipping means here and prepare it — commit message, branch, push. Put the proposed commit message in commit_msg; the user may edit it before approving. Do not push past the gate.
